correctness.rationale: For each n≥4, unsigned incidence BB^T=(n−2)I+J proves rank and common leverage q=(n−3)/(n−1). Cauchy–Schwarz, attained by Qe/q, gives exact inner radius. Even n: odd row length forces ≥1 zero for the sharp row-square bound, realized by deleting a matching and alternating an Euler tour. Odd n: independent unsaturated columns force tree/odd-unicyclic components; leaf parity excludes tree branches and an odd cycle has integral free coordinates, hence all free entries vanish. The zero graph has even degrees; Euler tours realize no zeros if n≡1 mod4 and a triangle deletion if n≡3 mod4, establishing every outer equality case. Every invariant quadratic form reduces to an edge Euclidean scalar on the kernel; averaging any Hilbertian pullback over S_n proves global optimality. Standalone exact projection and Eulerian-witness checks n4..19 and 160 LP checks corroborate but are not substituted for this analytic proof. Residual correctness risk lies in all-n extreme-point/case arguments; independently auditable proof supplied.
